name: dbt Summit 2026 (formerly Coalesce)
why: The flagship modern-data-stack event, now leaning into the analytics + AI convergence. This is where analytics engineers and the tooling crowd gather — strong for both learning and meeting practitioners at data-forward employers.
tip: Discounts for students, nonprofits, government, and groups of 3+.

name: ODSC AI West 2026
why: Hands-on ML / AI / data-science training in the Bay Area. Best pick for leveling up the technical stack, and the location means plenty of Bay Area data employers in the room.
tip: A free virtual expo/keynote pass is usually offered if the paid ticket is out of budget.

name: PyData Global 2026
why: The cheapest, most accessible way to stay current on the Python data and ML ecosystem — all online. Talks are practitioner-led and directly relevant to data / analytics engineering.
tip: Local PyData meetups run free year-round in most cities — great low-pressure networking.

name: Women in Data Science (WiDS)
why: Free, welcoming, and everywhere — the main event plus hundreds of local chapters worldwide. Excellent for meeting people in data and finding mentors and role models early in a search.
tip: Find your nearest regional chapter; many run their own free one-day events.

name: Gartner Data & Analytics Summit (US)
why: Where enterprise data leaders and hiring managers gather. Pricey, so worth it mainly if you are targeting larger organizations and want senior-level face time — watch for an employer or scholarship pass.
tip: Ask if a current or target employer has passes; individuals rarely pay full price.

name: Snowflake Summit 2027
why: One of the largest data + AI gatherings; many sponsoring employers recruit on the floor. Far out, but worth planning for — the networking-to-cost ratio is high if you land an early-bird or scholarship rate.
tip: Early-bird pricing and scholarship / diversity passes open months ahead — set a reminder.

name: Databricks Data + AI Summit
why: Among the biggest data + AI events, with a huge employer presence — a peer to Snowflake Summit. The 2026 edition has passed; the next runs in June. Strong for both the stack and hiring conversations.
tip: Free virtual keynote streaming is usually available if you cannot attend in person.
